Comments by item

Source: R/comments.R
delphi_plot_comments.Rd

Shows, for each item, the number of comments received in a round, split by the position of their authors: within the interquartile range or outside it. Items with many comments from outside the interquartile range are those on which the minority has argued its position.

Usage

delphi_plot_comments(x, round = NULL, indicator = NULL, type = 7)

Arguments

x

A delphi_data object with comments; see delphi_add_comments().

round

Optional round number(s) to show. NULL shows all rounds with comments, in separate panels.

indicator

Optional indicator on which the position of the authors is assessed. By default, a comment counts as coming from outside the interquartile range when its author lies outside it on at least one indicator.

type

Quantile algorithm; see delphi_describe().

Value

A ggplot object.

See also

delphi_comment_counts().

Examples

r1 <- data.frame(expert = c("A", "B", "C", "D"),
                 E1 = c(7, 8, 6, 2), E2 = c(3, 5, 4, 9))
x <- delphi_data(r1, expert_col = "expert", indicator = "impact")
cm <- data.frame(expert = c("A", "D", "D"), item = c("E1", "E1", "E2"),
                 comment = c("Depends on public funding.",
                             "Unlikely without new regulation.",
                             "The statement is too broad."))
x <- delphi_add_comments(x, cm)
delphi_plot_comments(x)
